title: 政策加码进行时：大规模刺激难产，门槛高在何处
speaker: Xiao Jiajue

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, you cut your growth forecast this year to 4.5 percent. So, what do they still need to do to get to that target?
segments.zh: 您将今年增长预测下调至4.5%，要实现目标还需做什么？

segments.en: I think they are already wrapping up the policy, but it's mostly implementation of what has already been planned in the budget.
segments.zh: 我认为政策已在加码，但主要是落实预算中已有的计划。

segments.en: We are seeing fiscal spending quickening, government banning issues so far in the first eight months is still behind the budget schedule, but China is also quickening this process fiscal spending through its 800 billion in these new policy financing tools,
segments.zh: 财政支出在加快，前八个月政府债券发行仍落后于预算进度，但中国正通过8000亿政策性金融工具加快支出。

segments.en: and we are seeing some of the set of measures try to stabilize the property market and also introduce more of the interest subsidies for consumption and to services providers and et cetera.
segments.zh: 同时出台措施稳定地产市场，并为消费和服务业提供更多利息补贴。

segments.en: These, I think, are definitely in a positive direction with all these through of measures showing that they are becoming more willing to do something more urgently,
segments.zh: 这些措施方向积极，显示政策制定者更愿意采取紧急行动。

segments.en: but I think they, as long as they feel they are confident enough to maintain this growth trajectory in the medium to long-term, that is going to be more led by technology innovation in natural upgrade.
segments.zh: 只要他们对中长期增长轨迹有信心，增长将更多由技术创新和产业升级驱动。

segments.en: I think the holder for the Chinese government to really introduce very aggressive demand stimulus is rather high.
segments.zh: 我认为中国政府推出非常激进的需求刺激措施的门槛相当高。
